claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise it as a gentle, alcohol-free alternative that doesn't sting, burn, or dry out skin, especially for people with eczema.
Many reviewers say it doesn't leave sticky residue, absorbs quickly, and has little to no odor.
Several reviewers value its versatility, using it on surfaces and other items as well as hands.
Some reviewers note a slight chlorine scent initially, though not overbearing.
One reviewer complains it feels like water and that products no longer claim antimicrobial properties.
